subtitle: Authority vs. Ruin — Starter Decks v0.1

cards.name: Site Security Officer
cards.text: When deployed, if Breach is 3+, Suppress 1 target Anomaly.

cards.name: Containment Specialist
cards.text: Your Contain costs cost 1 less Energy.

cards.name: Field Researcher
cards.text: Whenever you Contain an Anomaly, gain 1 Research.

cards.name: Tactical Response Agent
cards.text: Rapid Deployment. When deployed, you may Exhaust target Anomaly with Threat 2 or less.

cards.name: Combat Medic
cards.text: Exhaust: Restore 1 Stability. If Breach is 5+, restore 2 instead.

cards.name: Site Engineer
cards.text: Exhaust: Ready a Facility. Use only once each turn.

cards.name: Containment Team Alpha-9
cards.text: When deployed, Suppress 2 target Anomaly. Whenever Alpha-9 helps Contain an Anomaly, Stabilize 1.

cards.name: Director Evelyn Voss
cards.text: Other Personnel you control get +0/+1. The first time each turn you Stabilize, draw a card.

cards.name: Chief Containment Officer Hale
cards.text: Guard. Contained Anomalies you control cannot be Released by opponents while Hale is Ready.

cards.name: Security Outpost
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Authority Energy. If Breach is Critical: Exhaust, pay 1: Suppress 1 target Anomaly.

cards.name: Research Annex
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Analysis Energy. Whenever an Anomaly becomes Contained at a Facility you control, you may pay 1; if you do, gain 1 Research.

cards.name: Standard Containment Cell C-14
cards.text: Capacity 2. Exhaust: Generate 1 Authority Energy. Contained Anomalies here have their Released abilities disabled.

cards.name: Emergency Power Station
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Energy. Sacrifice: Ready another Facility; Breach 1.

cards.name: Central Operations
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Authority or Analysis Energy. At your Breach Phase, if Breach is 5+, you may Exhaust this; if you do, Stabilize 1.

cards.name: Suppression Baton
cards.text: Assigned Personnel gets +1/+0. Whenever it damages an Anomaly, Suppress 1 that Anomaly.

cards.name: Tactical Body Armor
cards.text: Assigned Personnel gets +0/+2. Reduce the first damage dealt to it each turn by 1.

cards.name: Portable Containment Rig
cards.text: Assigned Personnel gains: Exhaust, 2 Energy: Contain target Suppressed Threat 1 Anomaly. It does not require a Containment Facility until your next End Phase.

cards.name: Prototype Nullifier
cards.text: Assigned Personnel gets +1/+1. Anomalies blocking or blocked by it lose their abilities until combat ends.

cards.name: Black-Level Access Card
cards.text: Assigned Personnel gains Clearance. Once each turn, when you activate a Facility ability, reduce its Energy cost by 1.

cards.name: Secure the Subject
cards.text: Suppress 2 target Anomaly. If it is already Suppressed, Exhaust it.

cards.name: Evidence Collection
cards.text: Gain 2 Research. If you Contained an Anomaly this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Stabilize the Site
cards.text: Stabilize 2. If Breach was Critical before this resolved, restore 1 Stability.

cards.name: Termination Order
cards.text: Destroy target Personnel or Anomaly. If an Anomaly is destroyed this way instead of being Contained, Breach 1.

cards.name: Emergency Lockdown
cards.text: Anomalies cannot attack the turn they are Released. Whenever an opponent Releases an Anomaly, Stabilize 1.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.text: Create two 1/1 Security Personnel tokens. If Breach is Critical, create three instead.

cards.name: Information Blackout
cards.text: Counter an effect that would increase Breach by 2 or more.

cards.name: SITE-WIDE LOCKDOWN
cards.text: Exhaust every Anomaly. Suppress 1 each. Stabilize 3. Until your next turn, Contained Anomalies cannot be Released.

cards.name: Devoted Initiate
cards.text: Sacrifice: Generate 1 Ruin Energy. If Breach is 5+, also Breach 1.

cards.name: Cult Observer
cards.text: Whenever an Anomaly is Released, gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If it was an opponent's Anomaly, also Breach 1.

cards.name: Ash Preacher
cards.text: Whenever another Personnel you control is sacrificed, opponent loses 1 Stability.

cards.name: Breach Saboteur
cards.text: When deployed, you may Exhaust target Facility. If that Facility contains an Anomaly, Breach 1.

cards.name: The Herald
cards.text: Your Anomalies cost 1 less while Breach is 5+. Critical — Your Anomalies get +1/+0.

cards.name: Sister Marrow
cards.text: Whenever you sacrifice another card, gain 1 Research. Once each turn, spend 2 Research: Breach 1.

cards.name: Father Hollow
cards.text: Whenever Breach increases, gets +1/+0 until end of turn. If Breach reaches 10, restore to full Durability and Ready him.

cards.name: The Unnamed Witness
cards.text: When deployed choose: Containment — Release an Anomaly; Knowledge — Draw two cards; Ruin — Breach 2.

cards.name: Escaped Specimen
cards.text: Danger — Gets +2/+1 while Breach is 5+.

cards.name: The Pale Walker
cards.text: When deployed: Breach 2. Whenever it damages a player: Breach 1. Contain — 3, while Suppressed.

cards.name: Flesh Mimic
cards.text: When Flesh Mimic destroys Personnel, place a Mimic counter on it. It gets +1/+1 per Mimic counter.

cards.name: Subject 14
cards.text: Whenever it becomes Suppressed, opponent loses 1 Stability. Released — Remove all Suppression counters and Breach 1.

cards.name: The Weaver
cards.text: Whenever an opponent draws an additional card, they lose 1 Stability. Critical — whenever they draw any card, The Weaver gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Hollow Mass
cards.text: Overwhelm. When destroyed, create three 1/1 Aberration Anomaly tokens.

cards.name: THE THING BELOW
cards.text: Overwhelm. Costs 1 less for each Breach level above 5. Whenever it deals combat damage to a player: Breach 1. Catastrophe — after a Catastrophic Breach, Ready it; it may attack during your next combat even if it already attacked that turn.

cards.name: Subject ZERO
cards.text: Cannot be played while Breach is below 7. When deployed, Release every other Contained Anomaly. For each released this way, Subject ZERO gets +1/+1.

cards.name: Abandoned Site
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Ruin Energy.

cards.name: Ritual Chamber
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Ruin Energy. Exhaust, sacrifice Personnel: Breach 1.

cards.name: Blood Archive
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Ruin Energy. Whenever you sacrifice a card, you may pay 1 Stability to gain 1 Research.

cards.name: Compromised Containment Wing
cards.text: Capacity 3. Exhaust: Generate 1 Energy. Critical: Contained Anomalies here become vulnerable to escape effects.

cards.name: Excavation Site 06
cards.text: Exhaust: Generate 1 Energy. Once each turn when you deploy an Anomaly, you may Breach 1 to reduce its cost by 1.

cards.name: Unauthorized Experiment
cards.text: Draw two cards. Breach 1.

cards.name: Open the Cells
cards.text: Release target Contained Anomaly. Increase Breach by half its Threat, rounded up.

cards.name: Feed the Void
cards.text: Additional cost: sacrifice Personnel. Destroy target Personnel with Durability ≤ sacrificed Personnel's Power +2.

cards.name: Forbidden Knowledge
cards.text: Draw three cards. Lose 2 Stability. Breach 1.

cards.name: Ritual of Opening
cards.text: Additional cost: Breach 2. Release an Anomaly. It gains Rapid Deployment until end of turn.

cards.name: Mass Hallucination
cards.text: Target Personnel cannot attack or block until your next turn. Critical — target all Personnel controlled by one player instead.

cards.name: Reality Fracture
cards.text: Each player chooses a Personnel, Facility, and Equipment they control. Destroy the rest of those card types they control. Breach 2.

cards.name: LET THEM OUT
cards.text: Play only while Breach is 7+. Set Breach to 10. Catastrophic Breach triggers normally. After it resolves, Anomalies you control get +2/+2 and Rapid Deployment until end of turn.
